_README.about: The config object of {{PROJECT_NAME}}: every setting that is not secret. container_config.env names it (CONFIG_BUCKET, CONFIG_KEY) and picks the block this deployment runs (CONFIG_BLOCK). Edit this file, run the unit tests, then make sync-config to upload it. Read once at startup.
_README.profiles: Settings several blocks share, by profile name. A block names one with PROFILE; the block's own keys win.
_README.service: The block a deployment runs when CONFIG_BLOCK=service.
_README.PROFILE: The profile a block inherits from. Optional.
_README.WORKERS: How many requests the service works on at once.
_README.EXAMPLE_ENDPOINT: An endpoint the service calls. Replace with the real settings.
_README.EXAMPLE_CREDENTIAL: A credential id, not a password: credentials.<id> in the secret named by AWS_SECRET_NAME. Any key ending in _CREDENTIAL is looked up there.
